title: Money Values and Transactions to RM100
introduction: Explore money values and transactions to rm100 using everyday examples.
definition: Recognise Malaysian notes and coins and combine their values. Write ringgit amounts with two decimal places; convert sen to ringgit by dividing by 100.

examples.question: Two RM20 notes, one RM10 note and 50 sen.

exercises.question: RM100 paid for RM73.50. Change RM?

summary: Recognise Malaysian notes and coins and combine their values. Write ringgit amounts with two decimal places; convert sen to ringgit by dividing by 100.
